# Hugging Face discovery fixture

`doc-yaml-3.json` records the `sha`, `cardData`, and `siblings` fields returned by
the public Hub API for `datasets-examples/doc-yaml-3` at commit
`2bb86c4a45b9e98af9e95d8c1ce76e3b7578218f`, retrieved on 2026-11-06.
Other response fields are omitted. Tests use this checked-in metadata offline.

- [Pinned repository](https://huggingface.co/datasets/datasets-examples/doc-yaml-3/tree/2bb86c4a45b9e98af9e95d8c1ce76e3b7578218f)
- [Metadata API](https://huggingface.co/api/datasets/datasets-examples/doc-yaml-3/revision/2bb86c4a45b9e98af9e95d8c1ce76e3b7578218f)
- [Official manual configuration guide](https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/datasets-manual-configuration)
